public_rationale: There is a credible mechanism: DeepSeek describes regulatory limits on its hardware and engineering choices that address those limits. That is stronger evidence than simple coincidence. But adaptation alone does not establish that controls raised its technical capabilities beyond what its researchers would otherwise have achieved. The founder also described chip bans as an obstacle. The available records support pressure to innovate without settling the claimed causal improvement.
limitations: Technical development accounts come primarily from DeepSeek.
